title: Great guide -...
text: Great guide - knowledgeable and flexible. Great with children - patient and made history come to life!
author: Mary_H

title: Our children had a great time
text: Our children had a great time just like us. The guide knew how to transmit knowledge about Barcelona in an enjoyable and easy to understand way for children. In addition, we were able to visit the most important attractions of the historical center of the city
author: 712ferranp
